entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand tracker. I got it a month ago and it's useless. I want my money back.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a personal preference issue?
It doesn't matter why! I don't want it! I've had it for 30 days and I want to send it back. Are you going to help me or am I going to have to talk to your manager?

I understand your frustration, sir. I just need to check the return eligibility. Usually, for wearable devices, our current **policy** is very strict about returns after a certain point because of **hygiene** and **sanitation** concerns. For a device you've had for 30 days, it might be **too late**.
TOO LATE?! That's outrageous! I will light you up on social media! This is a scam! What kind of garbage policy is that? I want to speak to your supervisor right now!
Sir, there's no need for that. Please allow me to just confirm the specific policy tied to your purchase date. Can I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Fine. It's angrycustomer@email.com. But you're wasting my time. I'm already writing the review.

Okay, one moment... I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see your VeloBand GPS Tracker purchase from December. Let me just check the terms... Ah. Okay, my apologies, sir. It seems I was mistaken.
What? What are you talking about?

It looks like your purchase was made under our previous return guidelines. You're absolutely right. My apologies. The documentation I was referencing was updated after your purchase. Your item is eligible for return for up to 90 days.
Oh. So you can process the return then?

Yes, absolutely. Since you're only on day 30, you're well within the timeframe. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now and sending it to the email on file. Is angrycustomer@email.com correct?
Yes, that's the one. So it's a full refund?
Correct. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. The email with the label has just been sent.
Okay. Good. That's all I needed.
Perfect. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
